Its products - rolled products, as cast blooms and rounds, pig iron and foundry coke - are sold primarily to the Indian forging industry, with Indian and international component manufacturers forming a significant part of the clientele. risks.note: Identified in the BRSR as a material risk with negative financial implication because production is derived from the MBF route, which is an emission-intensive process; mitigation is a commitment to prevent, abate and mitigate air emissions and to adopt best available technologies.
risks.risk: Air emissions and air quality management

risks.note: Flagged as a material risk - non-compliance with safety measures may lead to liabilities and operational and financial loss, and incidents may adversely affect employee morale and Company reputation; mitigated through health care services at each location and regular training.

The Company requires a large quantity of water in its processes; water is a vital yet limited resource and its scarcity poses a significant risk with negative impact. Mitigation is optimum consumption through Reduce, Recycle and Reuse and a Wastewater Treatment Plant treating 100% of wastewater into reusable water.

Listed as a material risk in the BRSR; mitigation is employee-friendly policies and practices for growth, development and work satisfaction. The permanent-employee turnover disclosure in the same report shows meaningful attrition across FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26.
risks.risk: Human capital - attracting, developing and retaining talent

risks.note: Structural rather than labelled: manufacturing of forging and engineering quality carbon and alloy steel, pig iron and foundry coke accounts for 97.03% of turnover, and exports contribute only 0.59% of total turnover, so the business is almost entirely exposed to Indian forging and vehicle-component demand.
risks.risk: Concentration on a single manufacturing activity and on the domestic forging / automotive value chain

risks.note: Framed in the BRSR as an opportunity - identification of evolving demand dynamics helps in meeting operational guidance - with the response being introduction of value-added products and product diversification per customer requirements; the flip side is exposure to demand cycles.
risks.risk: Dependence on demand dynamics in domestic and export markets (economic performance)

risks.note: The Directors' Report states foreign exchange risk is managed with appropriate hedging activities using Forward Exchange Contracts against firm commitments, and that there were no materially uncovered exchange risks.

Treated in the BRSR as an opportunity with positive financial outcomes, addressed through increased customer interaction on quality requirements, quicker response times and long-term agreements with customers - implying dependence on sustaining those long-term customer relationships.
